latestVersion.changelog:
interop-forge 0.1.1

- Added explicit package manager detection and compatibility: pnpm, yarn berry, and npm now all supported.
- Updated planning protocol and behavior to auto-detect and adapt workspace/command generation to the user’s package manager.
- Clarified default to pnpm but respect for user’s existing lockfiles or explicit package manager requests.
- Documentation improved to reflect all package manager support and corresponding workspace config conventions.
